rules.INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID: either arm incomplete, or a correctness/data-isolation/checkpoint gate fails, or an unexplained configuration difference exists
rules.SCREEN_MIXED: both arms complete 6 epochs; D6 >= +0.003; but not all SCREEN_PROMISING conditions hold
rules.SCREEN_PROMISING: both arms complete 6 epochs; D6 = AP_T6 - AP_M6 >= +0.003; AP_T6 >= AP0; at least 64 of 127 scorable tasks have T > M

decision.statistical_claim: the +0.003 floor is a resource-decision threshold, not a significance threshold and not a guarantee of the next full-run gain
